summary: PT extension after knee replacement with measured progress and a clear plan

request.clinical_notes: Progress note, visit 18. Right total knee arthroplasty 7 weeks ago. Knee flexion improved from 85 to 110 degrees and timed up-and-go from 18 to 11 seconds since the initial evaluation. Still unable to climb stairs reciprocally. Plan of care: 8 more visits, twice weekly for 4 weeks, goals of 120 degrees flexion and reciprocal stair climbing. Treatment includes manual therapy for joint mobility and gait training, which require a therapist.
